Name: Haley's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i][color=#f4f4f4]Haley's Less Ugly House[/color][/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description.[/size]

[size=3]I do think that Haley and Emily is canonically (In my head) a fairly well off household, with Emily working at the bar and Haley... well, being Haley (Hey, photography isn't a cheap hobby ok!). So I decided to do a teeeensy edit to have their home to sort of reflect that pseudo-boujee lifestyle I envisioned them having.[/size]
[b][size=1](Also I had to change one of the plants by the entrance last minute, so the screenshots are accurate minus one plant :p)[/size][/b]

[b][i][size=3]You less Emily-d Emily's room![/size]
[/i][/b][size=3]Yes I did, what are you gonna do about it? >:)[/size]

[size=3]Just kidding. In canon (I think) Emily is staying at her parents room, which was why I took of more a neutral mature-esk tone to it. Only adding a bit of Emily's spice in one of the accent walls and a few plants and crystals scattered around. [/size]
[size=3]I'd also like to warn you beforehand that one of Emily's cutscene where she boogies might not be super immersive since her jukebox looks to be mounted to one of the walls. It's a minor issue though.[/size][size=3]
[b]
[/b][i][u][color=#ea9999][size=5][b]NEW!! 1.0.4[/b][/size][/color]

[/u][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Added an [u][b][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/b][/u] version - This ones more recolor friendly, plus the new 1.5 special orders cutscene won't look weird. Both works fine, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to toggle through.[/size]
[*]Added a new dependency, now needs EML or EML for Android if you're on mobile!
[/list][/size]﻿
[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][size=5]

[color=#ff0000][b][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/b][/color][/size]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][b][color=#ff0000][u][size=5][i]DOESN'T[/i][/size][/u][i] [/i][/color][/b][size=5]do:[/size]

[size=4][b]1. Gives sittable couches
[/b][/size]
[size=3] Some couches in the [color=#d9d2e9][b][u]Original[/u][/b][/color] version isn't sittable. Sue me.[/size]
[b][size=1](I know there's a way to make is so they're functional, but honestly not feeling that sort of work yet, maybe in the future :p)[/size][/b]

[size=4][s][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/s][/size][size=3][s]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine [b]without[/b] any mods that expands on the households story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside their home.

[b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.

[/b][/s]As of 1.0.3, custom cutscenes should work fine with the [u][b][color=#a4c2f4]Optiona[/color][/b][/u][color=#a4c2f4][u][b]l[/b][/u][/color] version.[/size]


[size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], if it adds a cutscene inside their home, you might experience some clipping issues. Otherwise should be okay![/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]read above :)[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], Idk if it edits their house tbh. If it does, then It's unlikely.[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#ff7700][u]Haley/Emily [/u][u]Expansions[/u][/color][/b], it's a maybe in the [color=#d9d2e9][u][b]Original[/b][/u][/color] version, but the [b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/u][/b] version should be fine.

[b]Regarding Haley/Emily Expansions[/b][size=3], read above.[/size]
[b]Regarding SVE[/b], [/size][size=3]if it edits the interior of their house, then that'll be a no. Sorry![/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]
[/size][/u][size=3]
1. Install Content Patcher and Extra Map Layers (EML for Android if you're on mobile!)
2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size][/font]
